ans.section1.title: 1 – Introduction
ans.section1.p1: This document contains the Service Level Agreement ("SLA") governing the use of "evolo", Calcul Québec's e-learning platform. According to the CQ Terms of Use¹, this SLA includes additional terms and conditions specific to evolo and sets out the specific level of service that is being offered to You. This SLA is entered by Calcul Quebec ("CQ") and You. This SLA takes effect when You accept these terms or when You first use evolo.
ans.section2.title: 2 – Definitions
ans.section2.p1: Information Security definitions are available in the {glossaryLink}².
ans.section3.title: 3 – Specific Terms of Use for evolo
ans.section3.p1: This SLA is an extension of CQ's Terms of Use and, as such, You must comply with the terms and conditions set forth in both this SLA and CQ's Terms of Use.
ans.section3.p2: evolo is designed to provide training content. The computing resources available through this service cannot be used for other purposes, such as research, development, computing, or data storage. All data stored on evolo may be destroyed at any time.
ans.section3.p3: Access to evolo is done via a third-party authentication service that delegates authentication to your associated educational institution. The platform does not store and does not have access to your password. Unless otherwise agreed, access is restricted to individuals associated with Canadian educational institutions. It is expected that you alone access your evolo account to achieve the learning objectives and obtain the resulting certificates. If you lose access to your institutional account, you will no longer have access to evolo and its content.
ans.section3.p4: In order to provide the evolo service, Calcul Québec must collect and use certain personal information, including your name, your account identifier, your email, your communication preferences, your academic profile, your learning progress, as well as activity logs. This personal information may be used by CQ for statistical purposes, learning analytics, continuous improvement of the service or its content, and to produce documents or communications intended for you. Your username on the platform and any exchanges you may have in the integrated discussion forum are visible to other platform users. Certificates obtained within the courses are verifiable and publicly accessible if you share the link. Your email may be used in accordance with your communication preferences.
ans.section3.p5: By accepting this Service Level Agreement for evolo, you also give your consent to Calcul Québec to collect and use Personal Information according to the terms established in this agreement.
ans.section3.p6: The use of evolo is reserved for personal and non-commercial purposes, unless otherwise agreed upon with CQ. If you wish to use it for academic purposes, you must obtain authorization from Calcul Québec. Academic use includes use within the framework of teaching courses, as well as within non-profit university research projects. Academic use excludes all commercial activity.
ans.section4.title: 4 – evolo Level of Service
ans.section4.p1: evolo is available in beta mode, with no guarantee of long-term availability. The service may be interrupted without notice.
ans.section4.intro: The evolo service allows you to:
ans.section4.feature1: Consult text, image, and video content authorized by Calcul Québec at your own pace
ans.section4.feature2: Access a learning environment similar to that of a computing cluster
ans.section4.feature3: Execute code within the framework of interactive exercises
ans.section4.feature4: Answer quizzes to assess your understanding
ans.section4.feature5: View your progress and obtain certificates
ans.section4.feature6: Exchange ideas with other students and instructors
ans.section4.access: All components of the service are accessible via the {siteLink}. Support related to the service can be obtained via the "Contact Us" link at the bottom of the service's website page.
ans.section5.title: 5 – Intellectual property
ans.section5.p1: Unless a more permissive license is explicitly associated with a subset of the educational material, all material available on evolo is the property of Calcul Québec. Any full or partial reproduction of the educational content, videos, audios, and visual elements of the evolo platform is prohibited without written authorization from Calcul Québec. Additional authorization from a third party may be required if the material to be reproduced comes from a collaboration.
ans.section6.title: 6 – Final provision
ans.section6.p1: CQ may modify the terms and conditions of this SLA at any time. If one of these modifications materially alters Your rights or use of evolo, CQ will use reasonable efforts to contact You, including sending a notification to the e-mail address(es) associated with Your account. In some instances, You may be required to indicate Your consent to the revised terms in order to continue accessing evolo. Unless otherwise specified, any modifications to this SLA will take effect on the date of the next renewal of Your account or when you log in back to Your account. If You do not agree with the revised terms, Your sole and exclusive remedy will be to discontinue Your use of evolo.
